name: Maine Mold & Machine
old_description: Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. specializes in plastic injection molding. With our molding capabilities, we can do the modification and repair of the molds, part assembly as well as plastic part production - all under one roof.
about:
Maine Mold & Machine, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Hartford, Maine. The company operates from a facility on Town Farm Road and has been providing plastic injection molding services for over three decades; as of 2006 it noted more than 20 years in operation. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in plastic injection molding and offers mold modification and repair, part assembly, and plastic part production all under one roof. It works with materials ranging from basic plastics to highly engineered resins, accommodating production needs from short-run sampling to long-term, high-volume runs.

The company serves a diverse set of industries, including industrial filtration systems, military components, medical devices, fishing equipment, and home gaming products, along with other specialty applications. Its customer base spans the New England region, covering Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island.

Maine Mold & Machine emphasizes its ability to handle the entire molding process in-house, from tooling adjustments to finished assembly, which it positions as a way to streamline production for customers.
